title: An Inexact Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for Constrained Parabolic Optimal Distributed Control Problems
summary: Solving parabolic optimal control problems can be inherently challenging in the field of science and engineering, especially with constraints on the nonsmooth distributed control. Motivated by the extensive applicability of the alternating direction method of multipliers, in this paper we develop a novel inexact algorithmic framework for parabolic optimal distributed control problems with control constraints.
